summary: The sensitivity qualification is correct: a budget change alone loses the contradiction, while establishing neither a realizable family nor optimality of support 53. I verified the frozen hashes and independently evaluated the displayed quadruple using exact integers.

checks.scope: Budget 58-to-59 sensitivity and its logical limit
checks.method: Substituted (19,14,13,13) into U and 6U-L²+6L at both budgets, then compared with the recorded diagnostic and threshold 4488.
checks.observation: L remains 31; U increases 875→888. The score increases by 6d=78, from 4475 to 4553, changing a deficit 13 into an excess 65. To prove support<=52 by contradiction requires n>=53, hence budget 59. This admissible tuple already defeats a uniform score bound below 4488 for the unchanged relaxation. However, its coordinates encode only necessary degree restrictions; they do not supply mutually consistent sets or attain the tail envelope. Stronger tail or incidence constraints could still prove a smaller support bound. The manuscript makes precisely this limited claim.
